name: player_load_weapon_banks_and_select_defaults
description: Player::LoadWeaponBanksAndSelectDefaults resets weapon-bank controllers, loads weapon specs from the master common data list, applies mission availability, selects default primary/alt controllers, resets timed-hit state, and registers the Mines ZAR callbacks.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Player weapon-bank/class source-cluster pass.
